body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{n,m}\), determine an explicit expression or certified finite-dimensional computation \(\Phi_{n,m}(h)\) and an explicit order \(q_{n,m}\), including every necessary logarithmic factor, such that uniformly over all \(n,m\ge1\) and \(h\in H_m\), \[c\Phi_{n,m}(h)\le\ell_{n,m}(h)\le C_0\Phi_{n,m}(h),\qquad c q_{n,m}\le\mathfrak A_{n,m}\le C_0 q_{n,m}.\] Derive one implementable family \(C_{n,m}^{\star}\in\mathcal I_{n,m}\), depending on the data and \(m\) but not on \(h\), with \[\sup_{h\in H_m}R_{n,m}(C_{n,m}^{\star},h)/\ell_{n,m}(h)\le C_0q_{n,m},\] and prove the matching lower bound over every \(C\in\mathcal I_{n,m}\). The characterization must remain valid at exact ties, heterogeneous near ties, cube boundaries, and separated profiles, and it must specialize to \(\mathrm{thm:exact-tie-oracle}\) and \(\mathrm{thm:low-information-profile}\). As an explicit high-information falsification slice, whenever \(na_m^2/m\ge C_0\log(2m)\), determine whether the mixed profiles in \(\mathrm{def:high-information-slice}\) satisfy, uniformly in \(0\le r\le m\), \[\Phi_{n,m}(h^{(r)})\asymp k\left\{\min\left(\frac{ra_m}{m},\frac{r^{3/4}}{\sqrt{mn}}\right)+\sqrt{\frac{m-r}{mn}}+\frac1{\sqrt n}\right\}.\] A valid solution must either prove this display or replace it with a contradicted profile and the correct constant-order expression. It must also evaluate the Bernstein-certified likelihood program in \(\mathrm{def:testing-handle}\): prove that the explicit choice \(D=\lceil n+C_0m\log(2m)\rceil\) attains the slice profile up to constants, or give a counterexample and an explicit sufficient degree or orbit-reduced complexity bound.
body.justification: This remains the unique construct-and-determine kernel: it must sharpen the capped-cell global upper envelope into the full local oracle, exact adaptation price, one attaining finite-sample family, and an all-procedure converse.
body.gap: The exact-tie and low-information regimes and a global \(\sqrt{m\log m}\)-ceiling upper bound are closed. Higher-information matching lower bounds, logarithmic necessity or removal, interpolation across \(na_m^2/m\asymp\log m\), the mixed tie--boundary slice, and an explicit sufficient Bernstein degree remain open.
body.consumer: Resolving the question would calibrate when the two sharp sensitivity endpoints can be reported precisely under heterogeneous ties. It would inform the same endpoint algebra used by the Project STAR application without claiming that the actual Project STAR sampling law is the paired-cell experiment.

obligation.what_is_open: Above the low-information regime, determine the full heterogeneous local honest oracle, the sharp simultaneous adaptation factor, a matching all-procedure lower bound, one profile-independent finite-sample honest family attaining that factor, and a sufficient Bernstein degree. In particular, decide whether the new square-root of m log m global ceiling is sharp, whether its logarithm is removable, how the optimal family interpolates across the elbow where n a_m squared over m is of logarithmic order, and prove or refute the displayed mixed tie--boundary slice.
obligation.obstruction: The exact biased-corner mixture has chi-square bounded by exp(4 n squared a_m to the fourth over m) minus one and ceases to be contiguous beyond the proved low-information regime. The capped quadratic rule is sharp at the exact tie but does not deliver reference-specific connected-interval lengths for arbitrary heterogeneous gaps. The capped-cell rectangle supplies a global upper envelope, but no matching higher-information composite-testing lower bound controls its square-root m log m ceiling, and no argument controls the expected hull enlargement after profile selection. The Bernstein coefficient relaxation is still not known to be exact at any explicit degree on the required high-information slice.
obligation.attempted: The exact multinomial likelihood inner product, biased corner mixtures at arbitrary references, fixed-sign one-sided honest intervals, the capped quadratic U-statistic, and the capped-cell simultaneous rectangle have been evaluated. These close the exact tie for all n, the full cube below the corner-mixture threshold, and a global upper envelope. They do not evaluate the heterogeneous connected-interval oracle, prove sharpness or logarithmic necessity of that envelope, construct a globally oracle-optimal selector, or certify nesting and a sufficient Bernstein degree.
obligation.partial_result:
The closed part consists of three uniform statements. First,
\[
 \ell_{n,m}(0)\asymp
 k\min\{a_m,m^{1/4}n^{-1/2}\}
 \qquad\text{for every }n,m.
\]
Second, uniformly over \(h\in H_m\),
\[
 \ell_{n,m}(h)\asymp
 k\{2a_m-T_0(h)-T_1(h)+\min(a_m,n^{-1/2})\},
 \qquad
 \mathfrak A_{n,m}\asymp\max\{1,a_m\sqrt n\},
 \qquad
 n\leq\frac{\sqrt m}{20a_m^2}.
\]
Third, the capped-cell coordinate rectangle is one implementable, profile-independent, finite-sample honest rule satisfying
\[
 \sup_{h\in H_m}
 R_{n,m}(C^{\mathrm{caprect}}_{n,m},h)
 \leq
 C_0k\min\left\{
 a_m,\sqrt{\frac{m\log(6m/\delta_0)}{n}}
 \right\}.
\]
Together with \(\mathrm{thm:oracle-positivity}\), this yields the global upper envelope
\[
 \mathfrak A_{n,m}
 \leq
 C_0
 \frac{\min\{a_m,\sqrt{m\log(6m/\delta_0)/n}\}}
      {\min\{a_m,n^{-1/2}\}}
 \leq
 C_0\min\left\{
 \max\{1,a_m\sqrt n\},
 \sqrt{m\log(6m/\delta_0)}
 \right\}.
\]
This is only an upper bound. Its two nonconstant ceilings cross at
\(na_m^2/m=\log(6m/\delta_0)\), hence at
\(na_m^2/m\asymp\log m\) for fixed \(\delta_0\). No matching
higher-information lower bound, sharp heterogeneous-profile formula,
globally oracle-optimal family, or sufficient Bernstein certificate
degree has yet been proved.
